why: Multiple post-snapshot preprints claim full proofs (e.g. arXiv:2405.03731 'The union-closed set conjecture is true', May 2024; a claimed 'algorithmic proof' on ResearchGate), and the known lower bound on the conjecture's own constant was improved by Cambie in a Feb 2025 paper in the Electronic Journal of Combinatorics ('Better bounds for the union-closed sets conjecture using the entropy approach', building on Gilmer/Sawin's 2022 (3-√5)/2 bound.
